//: Copy to config.json and edit for your machine. Every key under a server overrides the matching key in `defaults`, which in turn overrides the game adapter's built-in defaults (src/games/<game>.js).
//servers: Keys are the names you type in Discord: /start server:ark. Use a-z, 0-9, _ or -.

ark.//installDir: Where the exe lives. Ark buries it under ShooterGame\Binaries\Win64; omit this and it defaults to steam.installDir.
ark.//mods: Ark-only. CurseForge IDs; the name is cosmetic, shown in /status.
ark.//autoShutdown: Per server. Omit to inherit `defaults.autoShutdown`; each server keeps its own idle clock.
ark.//commands: The whitelist behind /command server:ark name:<key>. Add an `args` block to let the command take free text, which is appended to the RCON string.

destroywilddinos.description: Wipe all wild dinos (tamed are unaffected).

broadcast.description: Send a message to everyone on the server.

palworld.//exeName: PalServer.exe is a launcher shim; the adapter already knows to watch for PalServer-Win64-Shipping[-Cmd].exe instead. Override with `processNames` if yours differs.
palworld.//settings: Palworld has no launch-arg config: the adapter patches RCON, the admin password, port, player cap and server name into Pal\Saved\Config\WindowsServer\PalWorldSettings.ini before each start (backing it up once as .sneeker-backup). Set `settingsFile` to point somewhere else.

info.description: Show the server version and name.
